title: pilosella cymosa subsp. heldreichiana
intro: Pilosella cymosa subsp. heldreichiana, commonly known as a type of plant in the dandelion family, is a perennial plant native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of digestive issues, inflammation, and fever, due to its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and purgative properties. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella cymosa subsp. heldreichiana include soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and acting as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, such as pilosine and cymosin, as well as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
